bio.summary: Chao-Ju Jennifer Hou (1964-2007) specialized in wireless sensor networks. Hou earned a BS from National Taiwan University (1987) and an MS (1989), a second MS in industrial and operations engineering (1991) and a PhD (1993) from the University of Michigan. Hou was on the faculty at the University of Wisconsin-Madison (1993), Ohio State University (1996), and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (2001), where Hou directed the INDEX group. Hou was posthumously named an IEEE Fellow in 2008.

bio.summary: David Musliner is a Fellow at Smart Information Flow Technologies (SIFT) with over twenty-five years of research in intelligent systems, including planning and control for autonomous systems, formal verification and autonomous cyber security. For the PhD dissertation, Musliner designed the Cooperative Intelligent Real-Time Control Architecture (CIRCA), an AI planning and control architecture for hard real-time domains with safety guarantees. Musliner led SIFT's team in the DARPA Cyber Grand Challenge (FuzzBOMB).
